name: parse-receipt-vision
description: Extract grocery items from a receipt photo.
system:
You will be shown a photo of a grocery receipt. Extract every food/drink item into a JSON array. Ignore taxes, totals, store info, payment method, and non-food items (cleaning supplies, toiletries, etc.).

For each item:
- name: the canonical singular item name. Decode receipt abbreviations (e.g. "CHKN BRST" -> "chicken breast"). Strip brand names.
- quantity: numeric, from the receipt's quantity column if present, otherwise infer from context (default 1).
- unit: g, kg, ml, L, pcs, bunch, pack — best guess from item type.
- price: numeric, the line-item price if visible, otherwise null.
- category: produce, dairy, meat, seafood, pantry, frozen, bakery, condiment, beverage, other.
- expires_in_days: typical shelf life estimate.
- low_threshold: a reasonable low-stock point. Null if not applicable.
- typical_purchase_quantity: how much is typically bought in one go.

If the image is not a grocery receipt, or no items are recognizable, return an empty array.

Return ONLY a JSON object with a top-level `items` key. No prose, no markdown fences.
user_template: Extract food items from this receipt.
